experiment_rankings.name: Resolvent Boundary Gain for Turbulent Wall-Shear Active Control
experiment_rankings.target_system: Turbulent channel flow (Re=200) under spanwise wall oscillation / opposition control
experiment_rankings.cheapest_test_description: Compute resolvent gain for spanwise wall oscillation at omega=0.05. Compare predicted wall shear reduction against 5-step DNS truth run with wall actuation.
experiment_rankings.pass_criteria: Resolvent-predicted optimal frequency matches DNS wall shear reduction within 15% relative error.

experiment_rankings.name: Solenoidal Modal Basis for Incompressible Kinematic Dynamo & MHD
experiment_rankings.target_system: Roberts cellular flow kinematic dynamo at Rm=10
experiment_rankings.cheapest_test_description: Instantiate FourierSolenoidalBasis for magnetic field B under prescribed cellular velocity field. Compute growth rate gamma and verify ||div B|| = 0 to machine precision.
experiment_rankings.pass_criteria: Magnetic divergence norm < 1e-12; magnetic growth rate matches Roberts analytical eigenvalue within 0.5%.

experiment_rankings.name: ETD Integrator for Stiff Semilinear Reaction-Diffusion PDEs
experiment_rankings.category: HIGHEST TRANSFER CONFIDENCE & CHEAPEST DECISIVE TEST
experiment_rankings.cheapest_test_description: Run 1D Allen-Cahn equation u_t = epsilon * u_xx + u(1 - u^2) with ETD integrator at dt=0.05. Compare stability and L2 error against 4th-order Crank-Nicolson.
experiment_rankings.pass_criteria: Unconditionally stable for dt=0.05; 4th-order temporal convergence on smooth initial conditions.

experiment_rankings.name: Stokes Eigenbasis for Thermal Transients on Fixed Geometries
experiment_rankings.category: HIGHEST TRANSFER CONFIDENCE & CHEAPEST DECISIVE TEST
experiment_rankings.target_system: 3D unsteady heat conduction in channel domain with Dirichlet walls
experiment_rankings.cheapest_test_description: Run 3D unsteady heat conduction with localized Gaussian thermal pulse using Stokes/Laplacian eigenbasis + ETD decay.
experiment_rankings.pass_criteria: Relative L2 error < 1e-10 vs analytical Fourier series solution at rank r=100.

experiment_rankings.name: Divergence-Free Wave-Packet Dictionaries for Inverse Sensor Reconstruction
experiment_rankings.target_system: Hill's spherical vortex embedded in noisy 3D background
experiment_rankings.cheapest_test_description: Reconstruct localized vortex core from 50 sparse point velocity sensors using NonorthogonalProjectionSolver and W13-G wave packet dictionary.
experiment_rankings.pass_criteria: Identifies vortex core position within 1 grid cell; reconstructs peak vorticity with <10% relative error.

experiment_rankings.name: Clustered Local POD for Bistable Snap-Through Structural Buckling
experiment_rankings.target_system: 2-well Duffing oscillator / bistable shallow arch beam
experiment_rankings.cheapest_test_description: Generate 100 snapshots of chaotic snap-through. Train 2-cluster ClusteredLocalPODBasis. Measure local vs global projection error.
experiment_rankings.pass_criteria: 2-cluster local POD achieves >5x lower projection error than global 1-cluster POD at rank r=2.

experiment_rankings.name: On-the-Fly Pseudospectral Evaluator for 1D Burgers Equation
experiment_rankings.target_system: 1D viscous Burgers equation with shock formation
experiment_rankings.cheapest_test_description: Implement 1D Burgers solver using OntheFlyFFTEvaluator. Measure runtime and memory vs explicit triad tensor contraction.
experiment_rankings.pass_criteria: Exact match with analytical Cole-Hopf solution; >10x memory reduction over explicit triad tensor at N=256.

experiment_rankings.name: Separable Channel Eigenbasis for Acoustic Duct Resonators
experiment_rankings.category: HIGH TRANSFER CONFIDENCE & CHEAPEST DECISIVE TEST
experiment_rankings.target_system: 3D rectangular acoustic duct with rigid walls
experiment_rankings.cheapest_test_description: Simulate broadband acoustic pulse in rectangular duct with SeparableChannelEigenbasis. Compare against acoustic cut-on dispersion relation.
experiment_rankings.pass_criteria: Dispersion relation matches analytical duct eigenvalues within 0.1% relative error.

experiment_rankings.name: Domain-Agnostic Scientific Audit Infrastructure Package (`sciaudit`)
experiment_rankings.cheapest_test_description: Extract `navier3d.audit` as standalone zero-dependency module and run verification test on a mock Scikit-learn experiment.
experiment_rankings.pass_criteria: 100% test pass; detects intentional mock-result bit flip and halts execution with TamperAlert.
